paper_record.title: Quantum-Geometric Amplification of Nonperturbative Interaction Scales
paper_record.abstract: Weak interactions at a two-dimensional quadratic band touching (QBT) can generate an exponentially small symmetry-breaking gap, $m\sim e^{-A/V_1}$, that cannot be captured by every finite order of perturbation theory. We show that the singular quantum geometry of the gapped QBT converts this beyond-all-orders scale into an algebraically enhanced response. The quantum metric develops a momentum-space hot spot whose Brillouin-zone integral diverges logarithmically, and therefore grows algebraically when the gap is dynamically generated by interactions. Through the inverse-frequency Souza--Wilkens--Martin optical sum rule, the same amplification appears in the negative-first longitudinal optical moment, even though the ordinary optical conductivity remains $O(e^2/\hbar)$ and its absorption threshold is exponentially small. We establish these results analytically for a massive QBT and verify them microscopically in an interacting kagome lattice model known to develop a spontaneous quantum anomalous Hall mass at its QBT from loop currents order. Our results identify quantum geometry as an asymptotic amplifier of nonperturbative interaction scales.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 量子几何在二维二次能带接触（QBT）系统中将非微扰产生的指数级小能隙转化为代数增强的物理响应。
one_sentence_summary.en: Quantum geometry converts exponentially small nonperturbative gaps in 2D quadratic band touching (QBT) systems into algebraically enhanced physical responses.

problem.zh: 弱相互作用在二维二次能带接触（QBT）处产生的对称性破缺能隙随相互作用强度呈指数级衰减，导致其在微扰论中难以解析且在实验中难以直接观测。
problem.en: Weak interactions at a 2D quadratic band touching (QBT) generate an exponentially small symmetry-breaking gap that is beyond all orders of perturbation theory and difficult to resolve.

approach.zh: 利用量子度规在动量空间的奇异性，通过动量积分将非微扰能隙的指数依赖性转化为代数依赖性，并结合光学求和规则进行验证。
approach.en: Utilizing the singular quantum metric in momentum space to convert the exponential dependence of the nonperturbative gap into an algebraic response via momentum integration, verified by optical sum rules.

main_takeaway.zh: 量子几何充当了非微扰相互作用尺度的渐近放大器，使得原本指数级隐藏的能隙在光学响应中表现为代数增强的信号。
main_takeaway.en: Quantum geometry acts as an asymptotic amplifier of nonperturbative interaction scales, manifesting exponentially hidden gaps as algebraically enhanced signals in optical responses.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究揭示了量子几何在关联电子系统中的普适放大作用，为探测难以观测的非微扰物理尺度提供了新的光学实验途径。
why_it_matters.en: This work reveals the universal amplification role of quantum geometry in correlated systems, providing a new optical pathway to probe elusive nonperturbative physical scales.

reason.zh: 该工作在理论上建立了一种将非微扰能标转化为可观测代数响应的普适机制，并给出了明确的实验观测方案。
reason.en: It establishes a theoretical mechanism for converting nonperturbative energy scales into observable algebraic responses and proposes clear experimental signatures.

reason.zh: 该论文涉及拓扑物态、量子几何与强关联物理的交叉，符合 PRL 的高影响力理论研究定位。
reason.en: The paper addresses the intersection of topological matter, quantum geometry, and strong correlation, fitting the profile of high-impact theoretical research in PRL.
